versions.subject: rule: format.com fs lolbin
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\format.com'
    CommandLine|contains: '/fs:'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/fs:FAT'
        - '/fs:exFAT'
        - '/fs:NTFS'
        - '/fs:UDF'
        - '/fs:ReFS'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
